Commander '''Voldt''' served aboard the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] cruiser ''[[Requital]]'', during the New Republic retreat from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. He was responsible for catching the many small ships that escaped the Imperial blockade. When he boarded the [[Core Courier Service]] vessel [[Messenger (starship)|''Messenger'']] he failed to discover anything to directly connect the ship to the New Republic, although he did plant a homing beacon in the vessel's cargo hold. This beacon allowed an Imperial [[Carrack]]-class cruiser to interrupt a meeting between the crew of the ''Messenger'' and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], and later led it directly to the location of the New Republic fleet, where it was destroyed before it could escape.<ref name="Retreat from Coruscant" />
